Area of a triangle

Definition

What is a triangle?

A triangle is a closed shape that has three sides, three angles, and three vertices.

The area of a triangle is the region enclosed within its three sides.

Select the color that covers the entire area of the triangular park.

Area of a triangle

General Formula

The area 'A' of a triangle is one-half of the product of its base 'b' and height 'h'.

Area of the triangle = Base Perpendicular height

Derivation

Area of a parallelogram= Base (b) × Height (h)
